provenance.inputOrigin: A child with an aliased defineEmits<Emits>() event and a defineSlots slot, both documented with JSDoc, consumed by a parent listener and a #slot template.
provenance.contractOrigin: The listener hover keeps the declared payload signature and appends its JSDoc; the slot-name hover shows the declared slot type and JSDoc instead of the generic v-slot directive card.

scope: Whole native-backed hovers for a component event name and a slot name, both carrying the authored JSDoc.
